title: STOP AI DESTROYING the cpu #ai #automatedsolutions
description:
Is AI agent overload slowing down your computer? Learn how to identify and stop AI processes using your task manager to restore speed.

If your PC feels sluggish because of background AI tasks, you need a quick way to regain control. This video shows you exactly how to locate resource-heavy applications and terminate them safely. It is a straightforward guide for anyone struggling with unexpected system lag caused by new software agents.

We walk through the steps of opening your task manager to monitor high CPU usage and isolate the exact culprits draining your system resources. By learning how to stop AI processes that are running unchecked, you can prevent your machine from overheating or freezing during heavy workloads.

This method is essential for users who want to maintain optimal computer performance without needing deep technical knowledge. Once you clear these background tasks, your system will run smoothly again.

Subscribe for weekly tech troubleshooting breakdowns, and comment below if you have noticed any specific programs causing your PC to slow down.
